name: svg-french-press-perceptron-mk1.5-s2-r3
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 950" width="600" height="950">
  <style>
    .component { fill: #e0e0e0; stroke: #333; stroke-width: 2; }
    .glass { fill: rgba(200, 220, 255, 0.3); stroke: #4a6fa5; stroke-width: 2; }
    .metal { fill: #c0c0c0; stroke: #333; stroke-width: 2; }
    .mesh { fill: url(#meshPattern); stroke: #333; stroke-width: 1; }
    .line { stroke: #666; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 4,4; }
    .label { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #333; }
  </style>
  
  <defs>
    <pattern id="meshPattern" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="8" height="8">
      <path d="M0,0 L8,8 M8,0 L0,8" stroke="#333" stroke-width="0.5"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>
  
  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="300" y="40" text-anchor="middle" class="label" font-size="24" font-weight="bold">French Press Exploded View</text>
  
  <!-- Connecting lines for exploded view -->
  <line x1="300" y1="100" x2="300" y2="800" class="line"/>
  
  <!-- Component 1: Lid with Handle (top) -->
  <g transform="translate(250, 100)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="100" height="20" rx="5" ry="5" class="metal"/>
    <rect x="40" y="-30" width="20" height="30" rx="3" ry="3" class="metal"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="-35" r="8" class="metal"/>
    <text x="50" y="-50" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Lid</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Component 2: Plunger Rod -->
  <g transform="translate(280, 200)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="40" height="150" rx="5" ry="5" class="metal"/>
    <text x="20" y="-20" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Rod</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Component 3: Filter Frame -->
  <g transform="translate(220, 350)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="160" height="40" rx="3" ry="3" class="metal"/>
    <text x="80" y="-20" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Filter Frame</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Component 4: Mesh Filter -->
  <g transform="translate(220, 420)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="160" height="30" class="mesh"/>
    <text x="80" y="-20" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Mesh Filter</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Component 5: Base Plate -->
  <g transform="translate(220, 480)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="160" height="20" rx="3" ry="3" class="metal"/>
    <text x="80" y="-20" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Base Plate</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Component 6: Carafe Body (main glass vessel) -->
  <g transform="translate(200, 550)">
    <path d="M0,0 L160,0 L140,200 L20,200 Z" class="glass"/>
    <text x="80" y="-20" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Carafe</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Component 7: Carafe Handle -->
  <g transform="translate(150, 600)">
    <path d="M0,0 Q-20,50 0,100" stroke="#4a6fa5" stroke-width="8" fill="none"/>
    <text x="-50" y="50" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Handle</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Component 8: Carafe Base -->
  <g transform="translate(200, 750)">
    <ellipse cx="80" cy="10" rx="80" ry="15" class="glass"/>
    <text x="80" y="-20" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Base</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Assembly arrows -->
  <text x="350" y="150" class="label">↓</text>
  <text x="350" y="280" class="label">↓</text>
  <text x="350" y="380" class="label">↓</text>
  <text x="350" y="450" class="label">↓</text>
  <text x="350" y="520" class="label">↓</text>
  <text x="350" y="600" class="label">↓</text>
  <text x="350" y="680" class="label">↓</text>
</svg>
